definitions.explanation: An Iwate specialty in which small bite-sized servings of soba are dropped one after another into the diner's bowl by a server until the diner puts the lid on the bowl.

examples.japanese: わんこそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{盛岡|もりおか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、ぜひわんこそば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I go to Morioka, I definitely want to try wanko soba.

examples.japanese: わんこそば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給仕|きゅうじ}→給仕：18148_kyuuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ふた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{終|お}わらない。
examples.english: With wanko soba, the server keeps dropping in more noodles, so it doesn't end until you close the lid.

notes:
わんこ is an Iwate dialect word for a wooden bowl (⟦{椀|わん}→椀：00419_wan⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- わんこそば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧: to take the wanko soba challenge
- わんこそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百杯|ひゃっぱい}⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat a hundred bowls of wanko soba
- わんこそば⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: wanko soba eating contest

CULTURAL NOTE:
A specialty of {盛岡|もりおか} and {花巻|はなまき} in ⟦{岩手|いわて}→岩手：32677_iwate⟧. Diners count their bowls as they go, and many restaurants give a certificate to anyone who reaches a hundred.
